name: 62703 · Springfield, IL
findings: ZIP 62703 (Springfield) has 220 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 92 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62703 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62703 (Springfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 92 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
